plugins.name: atomic-agents
plugins.description: Skills plus explorer and reviewer subagents for building, scaffolding, debugging, understanding, and auditing applications with the Atomic Agents Python framework. Includes the umbrella `framework` skill, action-oriented `create-atomic-schema` / `create-atomic-agent` / `create-atomic-tool` / `create-atomic-context-provider` skills, the `troubleshoot` diagnostic skill, the `new-app` scaffolder (emits AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md), progressive-disclosure reference material for prompts, orchestration, memory, hooks, providers, project structure, and testing, and isolated-context subagents for codebase mapping and code review.

skills.name: create-atomic-agent
skills.description: Build and wire an `AtomicAgent[InSchema, OutSchema]` — schemas, `AgentConfig`, `SystemPromptGenerator`, provider client, history, hooks, optional context providers. Use when the user asks to "create an agent", "add another agent", "build an `AtomicAgent`", "wire up an agent", "make a planner/router/extractor agent", or runs `/atomic-agents:create-atomic-agent`.
headings: When this fires vs the umbrella `framework` skill
Anthropic — Mode.TOOLS, max_tokens REQUIRED in model_api_parameters
Groq / Ollama / MiniMax — Mode.JSON in both factory and AgentConfig
skills.description_zh: 构建并连接 AtomicAgent[InSchema, OutSchema]，包括模式、AgentConfig、SystemPromptGenerator、供应商客户端、历史、钩子和可选上下文提供器；用于新建规划、路由或提取智能体。

skills.name: create-atomic-context-provider
skills.description: Build a `BaseDynamicContextProvider` that injects a named, titled block into an agent's system prompt at every `run()` — current time, user identity, retrieved RAG docs, session state, cached DB schema. Use when the user asks to "add a context provider", "inject X into the prompt", "give the agent dynamic context", "wire up RAG", "make a `BaseDynamicContextProvider`", or runs `/atomic-agents:create-atomic-context-provider`.
headings: Create an Atomic Agents Context Provider
When this fires vs the umbrella `framework` skill
In the calling code, just before agent.run():
Mutate before each run as needed:
skills.name_hint: 创建 · atomic · 上下文 · provider
skills.description_zh: 建立 BaseDynamicContextProvider，在每次 run() 向系统提示注入具名带标题的动态块，如当前时间、身份、RAG 文档、会话状态或缓存数据库模式。

skills.name: create-atomic-schema
skills.description: Design and write a `BaseIOSchema` input/output pair for an Atomic Agents agent or tool — docstrings, field descriptions, validators, error variants. Use when the user asks to "create a schema", "design the input/output schema", "define an `IOSchema`", "write a `BaseIOSchema`", "model the agent's output", or runs `/atomic-agents:create-atomic-schema`.
headings: When this fires vs the umbrella `framework` skill
skills.description_zh: 为 Atomic Agents 智能体或工具设计 BaseIOSchema 输入输出对，包括文档字符串、字段描述、验证器和错误变体。

skills.name: create-atomic-tool
skills.description: Build a `BaseTool[InSchema, OutSchema]` subclass — input/output schemas, `BaseToolConfig`, `run()` (and optional `run_async()`), env-driven secrets, typed failure outputs. Use when the user asks to "add a tool", "create a tool", "wrap an API as a tool", "build a `BaseTool`", "make a calculator/search/weather tool", or runs `/atomic-agents:create-atomic-tool`.
headings: When this fires vs the umbrella `framework` skill
Skeleton — HTTP-backed, with config and typed failure
Phase 4 — Wire it into an agent
skills.description_zh: 建立 BaseTool[InSchema, OutSchema] 子类，编写输入输出、BaseToolConfig、run/可选 run_async、环境秘密与类型化失败结果；用于 API 封装及计算搜索天气等工具。

skills.name: framework
skills.description: Guide for the Atomic Agents Python framework — schemas, agents, tools, context providers, prompts, orchestration, and provider configuration. Use when code imports from `atomic_agents`, defines an `AtomicAgent`, `BaseTool`, or `BaseIOSchema`, or the user asks about multi-agent orchestration or LLM-provider wiring in an atomic-agents project.
headings: When the user is starting from nothing
When the user wants to understand an existing codebase
When something is failing right now
When the user wants a review
skills.description_zh: 指导 Atomic Agents Python 框架的模式、智能体、工具、上下文、提示、编排和供应商配置；用于导入 atomic_agents、定义 AtomicAgent/BaseTool/BaseIOSchema 或项目中的多智能体与大模型连接。

skills.name: new-app
skills.description: Scaffold a new Atomic Agents project from scratch — create the directory, `pyproject.toml`, env file, first agent, and a runnable entry point. Use when the user asks to start a new atomic-agents project from scratch, says "scaffold" / "new project" / "start from zero", or runs `/atomic-agents:new-app`.
skills.description_zh: 从零搭建 Atomic Agents 项目，创建目录、pyproject.toml、环境文件、首个智能体及可运行入口。

skills.name: troubleshoot
skills.description: Diagnose and fix a failing or misbehaving Atomic Agents app — import errors, schema validation failures, empty or malformed LLM output, provider role/mode errors, history and context problems, MCP transport errors. Use when the user reports an error, traceback, or wrong behavior in atomic-agents code, asks "why is my agent not working / crashing / returning garbage", or pastes a `ValidationError`, `ImportError`, or provider API error from an atomic-agents project.
skills.description_zh: 诊断修复 Atomic Agents 的导入、模式验证、空或错误 LLM 输出、供应商角色模式、历史上下文及 MCP 传输问题；用于异常堆栈和错误行为。
